senses.gloss:
अहि अहि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. अंह्; according to
Sāy. fr. rt. हन् with आ prefixed and shortened, ‘one
that destroys on all sides’), a snake; the serpent of
the sky, the demon Vṛtra; a cloud; water; lead;
a traveller; the sun; a N. of Rāhu, the ascending
node; the navel; [cf. अघ and अंहु, pp. 1, 6; Lat.
anguis; Gr. ἔχι-ς, ἔχιδνα, ἔγχε-λυς and ὄφις
Lith. ungury-s; Russ. ûgorj; Armen. ôz; Germ.
unc; Mod. Gr. ἀχέλι]
—अहि-कान्त, अस्, m. air,
wind; (snakes being supposed to feed upon air.)
—अहि-कोष, अस्, m. the slough or cast skin of a
snake.
—अहि-क्षत्र and अहि-क्षेत्र, अस्, m., N.
of a country.
—अहि-गोप, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. guarded
by a serpent.
—अहि-घ्न, अम्, n., Ved. the
slaying of the serpent or demon (Vṛtra) who ob-
[]
structs the heavenly waters.
—अहि-घ्नी, ईस्, m., Ved.
killing snakes.
—अहि-च्छत्र, अस्, m. a kind of
vegetable poison; the plant Gymnema Sylvestre (?);
N. of a country; (आ), f. sugar; the city of Ahi-
cchatra.
—अहि-च्छत्रक, अम्, n. a mushroom.
—अहि-जित्, त्, m., N. of Kṛṣṇa, also of Indra.
—अहि-तुण्डिक, अस्, m. a snake-catcher or ex-
hibiter; see आहितुण्डिक.
—अहि-दत्, अन्, अती, अत्,
or अहि-दन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, having the teeth of a ser-
pent.
—अहि-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, enemy of the serpents or
of Vṛtra; (ट्), m. an ichneumon; a peacock; Garuḍa,
the bird of Viṣṇu; Indra.
—अहि-नकुलिका, f. the
natural enmity between a snake and an ichneumon.
—अहि-नाम-भृत्, त्, m., N. of Baladeva (as identi-
fied with Śeṣa).
—अहि-निर्मोक, अस्, m. or अहि-
निर्व्लयनी, f. the cast off skin of a snake.
—अहि-
पताक, अस्, m. a kind of snake, not venomous.
—अहि-पति, इस्, m., N. of Śeṣa, sovereign of
the snakes, also of Vāsuki and others; any large
serpent.
—अहि-पुत्रक, अस्, m. a kind of boat.
—अहि-पूतन, अस्, आ, m. f. sores on the hinder
part of the body (of children).
—अहि-फेन, अम्,
n. opium, the saliva or venom of a snake [cf. 2.
अ-फेन].
—अहि-ब्रध्न, अस्, m., N. of Śiva; one
of the Rudras; corrupted fr. अहिर्-बुध्न्यस्.
—अहि-
ब्रध्न-देवता, f. the twenty-sixth lunar mansion.
—अहि-भय, अस्, m. fear of a lurking snake;
apprehension of treachery.
—अहिभय-दा, f., N.
of the plant Flacourtia Cataphracta Roxb.
—अहि-
भानु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. shining like serpents; epithet
of the Maruts.
—अहि-भुज्, क्, m. Garuḍa, the bird
of Viṣṇu; a peacock; N. of a plant.
—अहि-भृत्,
त्, m. ‘carrying serpents,’ N. of Śiva.
—अहि-मन्यु,
उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. enraged like serpents, epithet of the
Maruts; (Sāy.) ‘endowed with destructive anger,’
or ‘with unimpaired knowledge.’
—अहि-मर्दनी,
f., N. of a plant.
—अहि-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
multiform or versatile like a snake, showing the same
variety of colour and shape.
—अहि-मार or अहि-
मेदक, अस्, m., N. of a plant.
—अहि-रिपु, उस्, m.
a peacock.
—अहिर्-बुध्न, अस्, m., N. of Śiva; cor-
rupted fr. अहिर्-बुध्न्यस्.
—अहिर्बुध्न-देवता,
आस्, f. pl. the twenty-sixth lunar mansion.
—अहिर्-
ब्रध्न, अस्, m., N. of a Rudra.
—अहि-लता, f., the
plant Betel; another plant.
—अहि-लोचन, अस्, m., N.
of a servant of Śiva.
—अहि-विदष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्,
snake-bitten.
—अहि-विद्विष्, ट्, m. Garuḍa; Indra.
—अहि-शुष्मसत्त्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one whose men
(the Maruts) hiss like serpents; epithet of Indra; (ac-
cording to Sāy. अहि-शुष्म means ‘of all-pervading
strength,’ and is to be separated from सत्त्वन्.)
—अहि-
हत्य, अम्, n. the slaying of the serpent or demon
(Vṛtra) who obstructs the heavenly waters.
—अहि-हन्,
आ, m., Ved. killing serpents or Vṛtra.
—अह्य्-अर्षु,
उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. gliding like a snake.

अही अही, ईस्, m., Ved., N. of a demon con-
quered by Indra and his companions; a serpent (see
अहि); a cow; (ई), du. heaven and earth.

1. अहिक, अस्, m. a blind snake, not venomous,
see अन्धाहिक; (आ), f., N. of the silk-cotton tree,
Bombax Heptaphyllum Salmalia Malabarica. (For 2.
अहिक, see below.)

अहिक 2. अहिक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अहन्, q. v.),
is found at the end of a few compounds in the sense
of lasting a certain number of days, e. g. दशाहिक,
lasting for ten days. See 1. अहिक above.

आहिक आहिक, अस्, m. (fr. अहि), the descend-
ing node; an epithet of the grammarian Pāṇini.

अहिंसक अ-हिंसक, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-हिंसत्,
अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or अ-हिंसान, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हिंस्),
Ved. not hurting, harmless, innocuous.

अ-हिंसा, f. harmlessness, not injuring anything,
one of the cardinal virtues of most Hindū sects, but
particularly of the Buddhists and Jainas; security,
safeness.
—अहिंसा-निरत, अस्, आ, अम्, devoted to
harmlessness or gentleness.

अ-हिंसित or अ-हिंस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. un-
injured, being unharmed.

अ-हिंस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, innocuous, innocent, harm-
less; (अम्), n. harmless behaviour; (आ), f., N. of the
plant Momordica Cochinchinensis, Spreng, (commonly
called Kūrkavāli.)

अहिण्डुका अहिण्डुका, f. a kind of small poi-
sonous animal.

अहित अ-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. धा), not placed,
not put, not fixed; unfit, improper; unadvantageous,
noxious; hurtful, prejudicial; hostile, inimical; (अस्),
m. an enemy; (अम्), n. damage; food &c. contra-
indicated in a disease.
—अहित-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ad-
verse, inimical, acting unkindly.
—अ-हित-नामन्,
आ, आ, अ, Ved. having as yet no name.
—अ-हित-
मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, not friendly-minded, hating, ad-
verse, inimical.
—अहित-हित-विचार-शून्य-बुद्धि,
इस्, इस्, इ, whose intellect is incapable of discriminating
between good and evil.
—अहितेच्छु (˚त-इच्˚), उस्, उस्,
उ, not wishing well, malevolent.

आहित आ-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धा with
prep. आ), placed, deposited; entertained, felt; com-
prising, containing; performed, done.
—आहित-क्लम,
अस्, आ, अम्, exhausted.
—आहित-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्,
noted or known for good qualities; [cf. आहत-
लक्षण.]
—आहित-व्यथ, अस्, आ, अम्, pained,
grieved.
—आहित-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, uttering or
making a sound noisy.
—आहिताग्नि (˚त-अग्˚), इस्, इस्,
इ, one who has placed the sacred fire upon the altar,
a sacrificer; a Brāhman who has kept alive a sacred
fire perpetually in a family &c.
—आहिताङ्क (˚त-अङ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, marked, spotted, stained.

अहिमकर अ-हिम-कर, अस्, or अ-हिम-तेजस्,
आस्, or अ-हिम-रुचि, इस्, or अ-हिमांशु (˚म-अं˚),
उस्, m. the sun.

अहीन 2. अहीन, अस्, m. (fr. अहि, q. v.), a
large snake (?).

अहीन 3. अ-हीन, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 2. हा), un-
impaired, whole, entire; full, luxurious; not deprived
of, not withdrawing; possessed of; not outcast or
vile.
—अ-हीन-गु, उस्, m., N. of a prince, son of
Devānīka.
—अ-हीन-वादिन्, ई, m. a witness capable
of giving evidence.
अहीर अहीर, अस्, m. a cowherd. See अभीर.

अहीरणि अहीरणि, इस्, or अहीरणिन्, ई, m. a
kind of snake, said to be two-headed.

अहीशुव अहीशुव, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a
demon conquered by Indra.
आहिकम् आहिकम्, a particle = आहि कम् (?).

आहिण्ड् आ-हिण्ड्, cl. 1. A. -हिण्डते, -डितुम्,
to roam about.

आहिण्डिक आहिण्डिक, अस्, m. a man of mixed
origin, the son of a Niṣāda father and a Vaidehī mother,
employed as a watchman on the outside of gaols &c.
आ-हिति, इस्, f., Ved. placing on; anything placed on.

आहितुण्डिक आहितुण्डिक or अहितुण्डिक, अस्,
m. (fr. अहि-तुण्ड), a snake-catcher, a juggler.

आहीरणिन् आहीरणिन्, ई, m. a two-headed
snake.
